reason: The README clearly describes a floating DSH client plugin whose primary user-facing purpose is offline Chinese chess entertainment with a local engine and optional LLM commentary.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 DSH 客户端悬浮显示的中国象棋休闲插件，支持本地人机对弈、棋局持久化和可选的 LLM 局势点评。
summaries.en: A floating DSH client plugin for casual Chinese chess play with a local opponent, persistent game state, and optional LLM position commentary.

capabilities: Provides an interactive Chinese chess game in a floating client overlay
Runs a local chess rules engine and AI opponent
Persists game state, settings, and overlay position in the browser
Can optionally call an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint for position commentary
